info.title: El Ancla public API
info.description: Read-only content for church sites. Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer sk_<keyId>_<secret>` (a site key) and the church slug in the path.

get.summary: The site settings of a church, in the requested language.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

404.description: The church has no site settings

get.summary: The people shown in a context (`team`, `preacher`...), in the requested language.

200.description: The visible people of the context

400.description: The context is missing or not valid, or the locale is not valid

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

get.summary: The directions and FAQ of the visit page, in the requested language.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

get.summary: The published simple pages (title and slug), in the requested language.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

get.summary: A published simple page by its slug (in any of its languages), in the requested language.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

404.description: There is no published page with that slug

get.summary: The ministries with a published profile and the ordered landing mosaic, in the requested language.

200.description: The visible ministries and the mosaic

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

get.summary: A ministry with a published profile and a page of its own, by its slug (in any of its languages), in the requested language.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

404.description: There is no visible ministry with that slug

get.summary: The blog index: visible posts, featured, categories, series, archive, most read and tags.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

get.summary: A visible post by its slug (in any of its languages), in the requested language.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

404.description: There is no visible post with that slug

get.summary: The calendar of a year (the current one by default): weekly activities, schedule exceptions and, when the year is published, its public events.

400.description: The locale or the year is not valid

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

get.summary: The sermons index: published sermons, featured, series, preachers and cited books.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

get.summary: A published sermon by its slug (in any of its languages), in the requested language.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

404.description: There is no published sermon with that slug

get.summary: Whether the church's channel is streaming right now. Always 200: not live when there is no channel or no platform key, and also when the video platform cannot answer (then cached for 15 seconds instead of 60).

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

post.summary: Counts an anonymous view of a post. Always 204: it does not say whether it counted.

401.description: The site key is missing, invalid or not for this church

429.description: Too many requests from that address
